topic.readerProblem: Understand a quote-only enterprise AI Search purchase without confusing annual credit allowance with monthly answer capacity.
topic.connection: Direct purchase decision for a named AI-search-visibility or GEO vendor; supports selecting measurement or execution after an AEOeye baseline.

assessment: Read final body and FAQs and checked the current plans and feature descriptions. The opening discloses the absence of a dollar rate. The key decision is the conversion between planned observations and vendor credits; the article refuses to manufacture that conversion. Essentials has no highlighted allowance rather than being labelled unavailable. Operational recommendations and proposed demo checks are explicitly buyer analysis.
